dialogues.speaker: "Children"
dialogues.text: Don't be scared, don't be scared! Penny's waiting for you to go back home.

dialogues.speaker: "Scaredy-Cat"
dialogues.text: Penny, looking for us? Home, home, let's go home quick!

dialogues.speaker: "Children"
dialogues.text: Let's go home, new friends, let's all go home. Penny's waiting for us there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! Let's go look for Penny. Mr. Hat and Ms. Skirt are probably waiting for us, too.
